About SportX

Building India's Largest Sports Opportunity Ecosystem

SportX India is a sports networking and opportunity platform that connects athletes, coaches, academies, tournaments, sponsors and the entire sports ecosystem — all in one place.

Join SportX Community →

Our Story

SportX was born from a simple belief — every athlete deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of their background or location.

We saw talented athletes struggling to find the right platform, coaches and academies lacking visibility, tournaments not reaching the right players, and sponsors finding it difficult to discover genuine talent.

So we decided to build a solution — a single, trusted platform for the entire sports ecosystem in India.

🎯 Our Mission

To create equal access to sports opportunities for every athlete in India, regardless of their background or location.

👁️ Our Vision

To build India's most trusted and comprehensive sports ecosystem that empowers athletes, coaches, academies and organisations.

💎 Our Values

  • Accessibility for all
  • Transparency
  • Growth & empowerment
  • Community driven
  • Real impact

The Problem

  • Lack of information about opportunities
  • Limited access to coaches and academies
  • No platform for athletes to showcase talent
  • Difficulty in finding sponsors and scholarships
  • Fragmented and unorganised sports ecosystem

Our Solution

  • A single platform for all sports stakeholders
  • Easy access to opportunities and verified information
  • Better connections and networking
  • Support for athletes, coaches and organisations
  • A stronger and more inclusive sports community
